differences.what: massing: the draft's 20 x 9.5 m hipped box is now the sheet's front block, 14.35 m deep and 15.43 m along the front, with its canted south-east corner, a canted bay on each flank and the rear range behind; the 21st Street face fills the picture's left edge as the engraving's does

the 21st Street face's principal light: render x 1135-1245 px, sill y 755, head y 395, against the engraving's x 135-225, sill y 790, head y 380; drawn about 20 px narrower in the render (the engraver draws it wider than the perspective of its own heights gives)

the hood over that light: the render's architrave and cornice hood (K09's restrained surround) over the light, against the engraving's cornice over a frieze carved with a running vine on two consoles; the frieze panel stands taller in the engraving (about 0.2 m) and its carving is the kit's plainer moulding
the stone sill course under the chamber light across the 21st Street face: render y 245-260 px, engraving y 205-235, about 0.2 m apart through the camera
the chamber light over it on the sill course, in a plain stone frame: render x 1135-1245, the engraving's x 150-235; its head is out of both frames

the stone basement under the brick, to the principal floor, with a barred light under the window column (render x 1125-1240, y 855-970; engraving x 140-225, y 890-1000); the engraving cuts the basement in broad horizontal bands where the render's side facing is plain ashlar, the same stone and tone

the canted south-east corner: in the render it spans x 1275-1470 px, in the engraving x 300-370; the cut is the 1911 sheet's (1.3 m at K01's 45 degrees), and the engraving's foreground is not in one perspective with its house (the camera's solve), so the two disagree on how wide it prints

the porch on the Prairie front: a pale stone column at the stoop's head (engraving x 410-460 px, render x 1620-1680 on the near column) under the porch's roof; the porch's entablature and deck the engraving's tree hides

the stoop's turned balustrade on its landing and down its cheeks to the walk: engraving x 370-760 px, render x 1610-2000; bulbous turned balusters on a moulded rail in both; the place differs by the camera's disagreement on the front (above)

the iron fence along the walk: spear-headed bars over a band of rings on a stone curb (K11's scroll band) with the entrance gate; the engraving's corner pier at x 1125 px, the render's at x 1470, the camera's disagreement on the foreground

the iron fence ALONG 21st STREET, across the whole foreground from the corner pier past the house's south face (engraving x 0-1125 px, y 985-1090): not built. K11 lays its iron runs along the street line only, and a side fence only in boards, so the corner lot's side-street iron cannot be built yet; the 1911 sheet draws a 6 ft brick wall on that line west of the house, later evidence
the urns on the gate's piers (engraving x 760-900 px): not built; K11's walk-gate piers carry caps
the cornice, the mansard and its dormers, the chimneys: out of the engraving's frame
colour: the engraving is monochrome; the brick's red and the stone's buff are the kits'

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
